data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ghana, meaning 'to take refuge', Ghunyah is a name that symbolizes safety, security, and protection. It is a name that resonates with the spiritual concept of seeking refuge in Allah. The name Ghunyah carries the meaning “A refuge or shelter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghunyah usually hope their child will grow to embody a refuge or shelter and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Ghunyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A refuge or shelter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghunyah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
